_brands: Brands a store sells as its own or exclusively (owner 2026-11-13: 'ryobi': Home Depot never in the upper stores). A search that contains the brand (whole words) gets that store first among the buttons, small line 'sells <brand>', and its nearest shop first in Near you. dept = the department used when the sorter has not labelled the name; depts = only inside these departments (an ambiguous word such as 'predator'); stores = at most two, and each must be on in 'stores'. on=false switches an entry off. Mined candidates are never added here by a program: apps/search/tools/shop-brand-candidates.py writes a file for a person to read.
